pose: Full side profile. A unique sauropod with two parallel rows of high spines running down its neck. Friendly, animated expression. Unlike other sauropods, the neck is held low and horizontal to keep the spines safe from the top edge.

framing_presets.WIDE_WEIGHT_STRIP_V2: Extreme wide shot. The dinosaur is floating in the vertical center of the 1024px square. Ensure 25% negative space BOTH above the back and below the feet. This creates a safety buffer so the feet are not cut off by the 17:7 horizontal crop.
